source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend diagonally adjacent, same-color pairs outward until blocked."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    # Extend away from each end of the seed pair. Other colors block a ray.
                    for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r - dr, c - dc, -dr, -dc),
                                                   (rr + dr, cc + dc, dr, dc)):
                        while 0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w and out[sr][sc] == background:
                            out[sr][sc] = color
                            sr += step_r
                            sc += step_c
    return out
'''
